basis: Exact Q1819804 tower footprint way138829597. The operator photographs DSCF8933 and DSCF8939-1 are viewed southeastward from Palazzo Maffei at the northwest end of Piazza delle Erbe: the broad northwest face has the small arched window, and the adjoining southwest face has the clock. Native +Z is that southwest clock face (bearing about 245.38 degrees); +X points southeast. The adjacent Palazzo della Ragione wings and Arco della Costa are separate buildings and are not included in this tower mesh.
